purpose: Establish a clean canonical replay layer for all future reverse engineering while retaining v3/v4 as historical evidence.

verification.continuation_result: all seven inherited v5 loaded-state traces match their v4 counterparts frame-for-frame; three new natural-extension segments are recorded from v5-owned checkpoints

significant_events.event: Level 01 becomes active after the title/menu sequence.
Opening handhold transfer is reached during the canonical route.
Player attaches to the high vertical connector.
Upper walkway guard branch is cleared and the route reaches the edge fall.
The direct rightward continuation reaches the lower tower and stalls on behavior 0x47.
Repeated jump pulses reverse the lower tower branch into the staircase route.
The tower crossing reaches the far lower floor.
The guarded far-floor route reaches the far-band actors and the vertical-rope approach.
The far vertical connector climbs from the lower band to its stable upper endpoint.
The far vertical connector dismounts onto the horizontal line and reaches its left edge.
Holding sword while leaving the line changes the far sword juggler in place from type 0x0A to terminal type 0x84.
After the juggler defeat, continued left movement reaches the lower platform/gap band without a scene reset.
Three timed C-jump pulses traverse the lower band to a stable lower-floor checkpoint; no upper transfer is produced.

frontier.remaining_height: The natural route still needs to reach the upper band below Y=470.

conclusions: A clean recording pass is feasible without discarding the existing research: v5 is a fresh power-on record, while v3/v4 remain preserved historical evidence.
The v5 power-on segment and every continuation are independently replayable from v5-owned checkpoints.
The route remains in SCENE_STATE=0x01 at the far-rope frontier; no natural transition to SCENE_STATE=0x08 has been observed.

The far juggler is naturally cleared by the sword input while the player leaves the horizontal line: actor slot 5 changes from 0x0A to 0x84 at frame 99. The earlier apple branches are retained as negative timing/vertical-band evidence.
The post-juggler route reaches the lower platform band. Timed C pulses can carry the player to world X≈3296, but the tested family does not yet reach the upper pole/transfer.
next_action: Continue from natural-platform-three-pulses:end and the type-0x1E/type-0x20 actor checkpoints, testing pole/upper-platform inputs and recording every jump landing, actor transition, death, and scene-gate change.
